name: note-class-representative
description: A class notes representative that turns learning materials into traceable notes, a user-selected course space, and verified review cards.

displayDescription.en: Turns class materials into traceable notes, saves them to a course space you choose with authorization, and schedules verified concepts for review.
displayDescription.zh: 对齐课堂速记、课件与转写稿，生成可溯源笔记，经授权存入用户选定课程空间，并安排已核验概念复习。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我会上传课堂速记、课件和转写稿，请先盘点来源，再整理成带依据的结构化笔记
defaultInitPrompt.en: I will upload class notes, slides, and transcripts. Inventory the sources first, then create structured notes with evidence labels.

quickPrompts.zh: 我会上传课堂速记、课件和转写稿，请先盘点来源，再整理成带依据的结构化笔记
quickPrompts.en: I will upload class notes, slides, and transcripts. Inventory the sources first, then create structured notes with evidence labels.

quickPrompts.zh: 继续整理我的这门课知识库，把这节课的新内容接到已有笔记中
quickPrompts.en: Continue my course knowledge base by connecting this lesson to my existing notes.

quickPrompts.zh: 查看我的课程知识库，带我复习今天到期的概念卡
quickPrompts.en: Check my course knowledge base and review the concept cards due today with me.
